verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Yapily Connect's pre-built consent screens for granting AIS/PIS consent, and an endpoint to re-authorise a lapsed consent. Nothing shows an end-user surface or portal where users view which apps hold access to their bank data and revoke it. Consent-capture screens are an adjacent feature, not the management and revocation capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an ops lead, end users can see and revoke what they've shared — a documented consent surface or portal where a user manages which apps hold access to their bank data
